collection.title: BMW 5 Series Touring 2004 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 5 Series Touring 2004 to 2010 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 23" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. The choice of rear screen wipers for this 5 Series Touring which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
